tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang byad 'grol ba dang bcas pa'i lag len rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// wā gin+d+rā nan+da ni rā bho gā ya na maḥ dpal stug rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs pa// gang sku bsgom zhing rigs sngags bzlas tsam gyis// yid srubs snying gi brtan pa rang dbang du// 'phrog byed gtsug tor 'bar bas rtag tu srungs// sgrub thabs rjes gnang bde 'byung ral pa'i klung*// 'dren mchog drang srong dza h+nu'i zhal sgo nas// legs brgyud zab khyad yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun// nyes brgya'i dri ma sbyong byed 'dir spel lo// de'ang 'dir khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ bdag bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par bsams/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba khro bo chen po/ sku mdog dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'bar ba/ me zhun gyi thigs pa 'dzag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sbom zhing thung ba gsus khyim che ba/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa me 'bar ba 'khor ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer glog ltar 'khyug cing spyan gsum dmar zlum phyogs bcu gzigs pas gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad gzir ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas byad ma 'byung po brdzis pa/

zhal nas sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas sprul pa'i khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa mtha' yas pa spros pas srid pa gsum 'gengs shing gnod byed ma lus pa tshar gcod pa/ thugs kar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas rang 'dra'i gtsug tor 'bar ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang du bya/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ thugs kar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po'i mtha' mar gzungs sngags kyis g.yas skor du bskor ba las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros/ nad gdon byad byur rmi ltas ngan pa dang dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul bzhin du brlag par bsams la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭhi te phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs nyer gcig la sogs pa gang 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'bar ba// gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags pa'i// khro bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ bdag la rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan pa ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang bgegs dang bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad phyir bzlog cig ces brjod cing thal mo brdab ste gnod pa phyir bzlog gi phrin las bcol/

gal te bdag bskyed rkyang pa nyams su len na skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar nyams su blangs la dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// gal te rmi lam ngan pa rmis na dran shes bzhin dang ldan pas lus kyi tshugs ma zhig par byas la/ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad sreg par bsam zhing sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa kho nas bzlog go /man ngag 'di la mchog tu yid ches pa dang*/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu ma yengs par 'bad pa ni gnad kyi dam pa'o zhes gsung ngo*// phyir bzlog gi bsgom bzlas dang*/ bstod pa rgyas pa rnams don du gnyer bas chag lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i yi ger blta bar bya'o// rjes su gnang ba ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ stegs kyi steng du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor rgyan ldan bshams pa'i mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ me tog sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams tshogs par byas la/ mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ tas bsang ba nas byin gyis brlab pa spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas kyi mthar thal mo brdab ste gnod pa phyir bzlog gi phrin las 'chol ba'i bar gong ltar nyams su blang*/ mdun bskyed ni/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma zhes pa nas rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gyis tshom bu lhar bskyed/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa dz+wa la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ gong gi bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lha'i ljags las byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas mnyes par bsams la/

rtsa sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams bos la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal gdab/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni rigs sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la rgyud sde sgo drug tu dbye ba las 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la nang gses kyi dbye ba brgyad du yod pa'i ya gyal de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes bya ba ste/ de'ang sngon tshe de bzhin gshegs pa sā la'i dbang pos gsungs shing*/ slar yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas dbang bsgyur gyi gnas su 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe bzlas te gsungs shing*/ rgyud de nyid las 'di'i rigs sngags gsungs pa/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭhi te phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags pa'i// sngags 'di sngags rnams kun gyi mchog /gang gis las rnams stong phrag ni// dgu bcu rtsa bzhi dag dang ni// bkra shis dpal grags thams cad dang*// rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams byed// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// lan gcig bzlas pas sel bar byed// las rnams gzhan yang byed pa ni// sngags rnams kun gyi bdag po yin// zhes bya ba la sogs pas mngon par bsngags pa'i yul du gyur pa gang de/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ras yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las mnos shing*/ de nas bhaṃ ga la'i paṇ+ḍi ta shū raṃ ka ra gup+ta nas bdag cag gi 'khor lo'i mgon po'i bar gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las legs par 'ongs pa'i gdams pa thugs gtsigs shin tu che zhing*/

bla ma gong ma rnams kyang phyir bzlog la 'di kho na mdzad pas 'phral du myong bas grub pa'i gdams pa khyad par can 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob dpon la khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba dngos yin snyam pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sogs kyis gsol gdab dang*/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba'i slad du dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum gyis rjes zlos byar gzhug dngos gzhi la rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i phyir du slob ma rnams swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma lhar bskyed la/ ye shes pa mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas gtsug tor 'bar ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ sngags kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā wa sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes btags pa yang yang brjod pas slob ma la bstim/ des gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs sogs kyis brda sprad/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de/ slob ma'i thugs kar 'khod pa'i dmigs pas sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug slob mas bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'thor ba'i bar dang*/

dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byar gzhug des gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs sogs kyis brda sprad/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re chad/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang dbyer med du gyur pa nas spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa'i bar 'dra/ des gtsug tor 'bar ba'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs sogs kyis brda sprad/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul gyis bzhes snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs ni spyi ltar brjod cing*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa zhes pas/ dge ba bsngos te slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// rjes ni/ mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod byas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas tshom bu'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gtsug tor 'bar ba 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod do// 'di la brten nas rang ngam bsgrub bya la gzhan gyis byad gtad kyi gnod pa dang*/ rmi ltas ngan pa sogs byung na byad chu bor bskyur ba'i gdams pa lag tu blang ba'i tshul ni/

chu bo chen po'i 'gram du phyin pa'am/ phyin par bsams la mdun du sla nga la sogs pa'i snod du chu blugs pa gzhag rang nyid kha lhor bstan pa'am gnod byed kyi phyogs su bltas pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar ra lug gi ril ma dang*/ bong ba/ spen ma brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar rigs pa bsham/ bsgrub bya la rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa rnams grub par byas nas rjes gnang gi thog mtha' gang rung du bya zhing zur du byed na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rang yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa'am/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i bsgom bzlas sngar ltar bya'o// de nas bsgrub bya yod na mdun du 'khod du gzhug la/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra nas chag lo tsā ba gong ma dgra bcom pa sogs la rim par brgyud pa'i khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba dang rjes su 'brel par/ byad chu bor bskyur ba'i las kyi rim pa'am spen gtor mar grags pa zab mo bsgrub pa la/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du zhes sogs nas/ gnod byed ma lus pa tshar gcod pa zhes pa'i bar gyis sngar ltar gtsug tor 'bar ba gsal gdab/ de'i g.yas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum gyi dbus dkar/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi na gdugs dkar po dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yon bzhi na rgyal mtshan dang*/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa dang*/ mda' dang*/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ shin tu khros shing ma rungs pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yon cung zad brkyang ba'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i g.yon du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing 'jigs par byed pa/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ dbu skra dmar po gyen du 'bar ba/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis log 'dren glang sna can brdzis pa/ de gsum gyi 'khor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig sngags kyi lha tshogs mtha' yas pas bskor nas bzhugs par gsal btab/ rang dang lha gsum gyi thugs ka'i zhes sam slob dpon dang mdun gyi lha gsum dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rang gi sgo gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon byad gtad la sogs pa gzhan gyis rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa thams cad tshur bsdus nas mdun gyi rdzas rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba khro bo chen po'i bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kun gyi bdag po lag na rdo rje'i bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib/ rmi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba thams cad dang*/

byad dang mnan gtad du bcug pa la sogs pa gzhan gyis rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa brtsams pa'i nus mthu thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas mdun gyi rdzas 'di dag la gnyis su med par thim par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i dgug gzhug lan gsum bya/ de ltar byas pa'i ril ma la sogs pa'i rdzas 'di dag nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer rlung gi shugs dang ldan pa dang sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rdzas de rnams rang dbang med par bdas te rgya mtsho chen por dor bar mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod de/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas spen ma thogs te 'phyags pa'i tshul dang bcas te 'bar ba'i gzungs sngags kyi mjug tu/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ a tsa le a tsa le/ kha ṣa me kha ṣa me/ khi ṣi me khi ṣi me/ she ṣa me she ṣa me/ bī ra bī ra/ bi ṣa me bi ṣa me/ sau me sau me/ shan+te shan+te/ dan+te dan+te/ badz+ra dha ra bhan+da bhan+da badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ban+dha ban+dha badz+ra pā she na sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bi nā ya ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba satwāṃsh+tsa swā hā/ bdag dang che ge mo la rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang*/ bgegs dang bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad ril ma bzhin du chus khyer cig bong ba bzhin du chus shig cig spen phyags kyis phyogs shig ces brjod cing*/ spen ma dang bcas pa chur dor/ de lta bu brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa byas pa'i mthar/ phyir bzlog par gyis shig med par gyis shig zhi bar gyis shig ces brjod cing thal mo brdabs pas khyed rnams zla ba sgra gcan las grol ba ltar sgo gsum bar chad dang bral nas bde ba dang ldan par mos la/

'khor gsum ga'ang dmigs pa med par shes pa'i lta ba zab mo'i rgyas btab ste/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// rang nyid kyis nyams su len pa'i tshe bar skabs kyi dmigs pa'i brda sprod rnams ngag gis mi brjod cing yid kyis bsam pa dang rang dang slob ma'i khyad par bsgyur ba min pa 'dra'o// 'di ni rang gzhan la rmi lam ngan pa dang byad kha dang mthu gtad drag po byas pa la sogs pa'i rtags byung na 'di nyid nyams su blangs pas de ma thag tu bzlog par 'gyur bar the tshom med pa'i gdams pa'o// smras pa/ rig sngags bye ba'i gtsug tor ngal gso ba// gong gi bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i g.yar lam du// bgegs dgra byad ma'i srog rtsa rdo rje'i khams// grub kyang skad cig gnyis par 'tsho 'am ci// gang de'i sgrub thabs rjes su gnang ba dang*// byad gtad chu bor bskyur ba'i lag len rnams// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' ngur smrig gar// rmor chen mkhas pa'i gsung don rnam gsal byas// 'di byas dge tshogs 'phong skyen dga' byed mdas// bar chad bsam sbyor ngan pa'i bden bral srog /yongs phrogs bdud las rgyal ba'i khang bzang du// kun mchog si tā'i bde la rol gyur cig /ces khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang byad 'grol ba dang bcas pa'i lag len rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chag lo rin rgyal gyi gsung rab dang rmor chen pa'i phyag bzhes ltar nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
